problem: With graphics_proxy disabled, both browser startup paths omitted the shared renderer bundle. create_adapter_renderer returned null, leaving native NV40 without a host 3D renderer while VGA/GDI and driver installation could still work. Native guest harnesses supplied their renderer explicitly and did not exercise this missing page load.
fix: Load the renderer bundle for native GeForce before constructing V86, independently of the guest API proxy option. Missing WebGPU/bundle produces a native 3D notice and preserves 2D boot.
